name: read_symbol_table
note: = shcmdl read_symbol_table 0040aad0 (same field order as shcmdl write_symbol_file 00404240). Called by shcgen_main 0041a860. Clears g_function_count, allocates g_symbol_table ((request +0xb0) + 0xb7) * 0x30 via malloc 0043a550 (fatal 0xbcd) and zeroes it (0042b250), then loops while the 2-byte symbol index read from g_sym_file is nonzero: index + 0xb6, flags |= 0x80, class byte, the class-dependent short for classes 3/4/9/11 (discarded), name (read_symbol_name), type byte, aggregate size when (type & 0xe0) == 0x60/0x80, bytes +03 +04 +05, short +06, reg +1e. Functions (type & 0xf8 == 0x48): class 1/3 -> read_function_info, others -> size = lookup_builtin_function_id(name) and flags |= 0x10 when nonzero. Class 1/3 non-functions with a name failing 0042b950 -> message 0x7e4. Class 10 -> read_scope_info; class 9 reads an int into +10. Classes 1..4 and 9 get their storage ea (+20): reg == -1 -> EAABS (0xd) with an 8-byte label_ref of the symbol (alloc_zeroed(8), 0042b1c0), else EAREGD reg (0042b180). At the end request->aux_count = g_function_count

name: read_function_info
note: = shcmdl read_function_info 0040b130 (shape: return type, size, byte, parameter list, scope list). Only caller read_symbol_table (class 1/3 functions). sym +1c = g_function_count++ (the function's aux record index); reads the return type byte into +18, a 4-byte size when (type & 0xe0) == 0x60 (discarded), byte +19, then +0c = read_parameter_list(), +10 = read_function_scope_list(), +14 = read_symbol_extension(sym). param_1 was int; every access is a sym_entry field

name: read_parameter_list
note: only caller read_function_info (result -> sym_entry +0c). Reads a 1-byte count, then per parameter a 2-byte symbol number (+0xb6) and a flag byte; a nonzero flag sets flags 0x20 on that parameter's sym_entry (shcmdl read_function_info: each parameter's byte goes to that symbol's +3). Stored 4 per 0x24-byte block (malloc ((n+3)>>2)*0x24, zeroed; {next +0, flag bytes +4..+7, shorts +8..+0e, 0x14 unused}), 0xffff after the last entry of a partial block, blocks chained through +0; NULL for count 0. Ghidra returns int *: the first block (struct sym_param_block in types_proposal.h)

name: read_function_scope_list
note: only caller read_function_info (result -> sym_entry +10). Reads a 2-byte count and that many 2-byte symbol numbers (+0xb6), 2 per 8-byte block (malloc ((n+1)/2)*8, zeroed; {next, short[2]}), 0xffff terminator in a partial last block, chained through +0; NULL for count 0. = the second list of shcmdl read_function_info ("scopes, see append_callee_scopes"). Returns the first block (struct sym_pair_block in types_proposal.h)

name: read_symbol_extension
note: = shcmdl read_symbol_extension 0040aed0 (same flag logic). Only caller read_function_info (result -> sym_entry +14), so shcgen reads extensions only for class 1/3 functions. When sym_flags (+04) & 0x10: malloc 0xc, zeroed; flag byte at +0; flag & 2: +4 gets 4 bytes, or with flag & 4 a 2-byte symbol number (+0xb6) whose sym_entry gets flags |= 0x08; flag & 1: 4 bytes into +8. NULL when there is no extension (or on allocation failure, fatal 0xbcd). param_1 was int (reads +04 of it); returns byte * = types.h sym_entry.ext unsigned char *

name: read_scope_info
note: = shcmdl read_scope_info 0040b320 (class 10 symbols: two lists). Only caller read_symbol_table (class 10). sym +0c = read_scope_child_list(), +10 = read_scope_member_list(). param_1 was int

name: read_scope_child_list
note: only caller read_scope_info (-> sym_entry +0c of a class 10 symbol). Reads a 2-byte count and that many 2-byte symbol numbers (+0xb6), 6 per 0x10-byte block ({next, short[6]}; malloc ((n+5)/6)*0x10, zeroed), 0xffff terminator, chained through +0. The first list of shcmdl read_scope_info (the child-scope list, symbol numbers only; shcmdl write_symbol_class10_lists writes it first). NOTE types.h calls class-10 sym_entry +0c "member blocks (00401870)": by shcmdl's naming this is the child-scope list and 004019a0 reads the members

name: read_scope_member_list
note: only caller read_scope_info (-> sym_entry +10 of a class 10 symbol). Reads a 2-byte count, then per member a 2-byte symbol number (+0xb6) and a flag byte (nonzero sets the member's sym_entry flags 0x20), 4 per 0x10-byte block ({next, flag bytes +4..+7, shorts +8..+0e}; malloc ((n+3)/4)*0x10, zeroed), 0xffff terminator, chained through +0. = the member list of shcmdl read_scope_info ("each member's byte goes to its +3")

name: read_symbol_name
note: only caller read_symbol_table (-> sym_entry +08). Reads a length byte and that many bytes from g_sym_file into a stack buffer, copies them NUL-terminated into the 0x100-byte string pool (g_string_pool_block / g_string_pool_cursor; a new malloc(0x100) block when the current one cannot hold len + 1; fatal 0xbcd) and returns the copy; NULL for length 0. shcmdl read_symbol_name 0040b040 reads the same bytes (calloc, length as a parameter); the pool scheme is shcpep read_asa_counted_string's

name: lookup_builtin_function_id
note: callers read_symbol_table (non-class-1/3 function symbols: result -> sym_entry +0c, flags 0x10 when nonzero) and 0042b950. If name starts with "_builtin_" (strncmp 9 with 004413b0) compares the rest with each g_builtin_function_names entry (00441220: set_imask, get_imask, set_cr, get_cr, set_gbr, get_gbr, ...) and returns that entry's short id (+6, DAT_00441226); 0 when not found

name: prepare_comparison_node
note: PARAMS: Ghidra's // sig line says (void) but the body reads the node from the stack (00401c92 MOV ESI,[ESP+0xc] after two pushes) and the late-handler call passes it: one parameter. Late handler (g_late_handler_kind 3) of IL_EQ/IL_NE/IL_LT/IL_LE/IL_GT/IL_GE (indexes 35..40 of g_late_handler_table), called by dispatch_and_finalize_code_node. Picks the compare template with 00422180 (g_compare_eq_select for IL_EQ/IL_NE, else g_compare_rel_select). Usage 1 (condition): a scratch register from the chooser 0041fa30 goes to cond_regs[0] (+0x38) (none for float compares without FPU). Other usages: the T-bit result gets a register (dest +74 when it is EAREGD, else target_regs via 00430f00, else the chooser with pref_regs) written as value +68 EAREGD, opnd_class 0/1, busy/temp regs and g_used_gpr_mask updated

name: prepare_logical_not_node
note: late handler of IL_NOT (index 5). Swaps the operand's true/false labels (desc +0c/+0e; makes a new label 0042b1e0 first when usage != 1 and the parent is not IL_NOT); a comparison / IL_AND / IL_OR / IL_NOT / built-in 0x10/0x14 call operand gets the destination passed through, otherwise a template is chosen through g_not_select (00423410) and 00431950; copies busy regs, frame top and preferences to the operand and runs dispatch_and_finalize_code_node on it; usage 1 marks the node handled (flags3 0x80 | 0x08); a constant operand is folded (0040ba90); value usage runs the template (00424c80) or takes the operand's value ea

name: prepare_unary_plus_node
note: late handler of IL_PLUS (index 1, unary +). Passes the node's destination (dest +74, target_regs, ftarget_regs, the stack-push flag 0x08, the memory-result flag3 0x20) down to its operand, generates the operand (dispatch_and_finalize_code_node) and, when nothing was forwarded, takes the operand's value ea (+5c / +74 / g_ea_pop / +68) and opnd_class; flags3 |= 0x80 | 0x08

name: prepare_dereference_node
note: late handler of IL_ASTER (index 3, unary *). Generates the address operand, then: aggregate results (type kind 0x80) take the operand's value; an address in a register / @(R0,Rn) becomes @Rn or @(disp,Rn) (EAIDREG / EADISP, opnd_class 3), @Rn+ / @-Rn (EAPOINC 4 / EAPRDEC 3) when the operand is IL_POI / IL_PRD on a register (0040d7d0); otherwise loads the address into a register chosen by 0041fa30 / 0041fc40 / 0041fde0 (float) via 00429060; function-typed results (0x48) get ea type bit 0x40; flags2 |= 0x02

name: prepare_address_of_node
note: late handler of IL_AMPER (index 4, unary &). Generates the operand, then: aggregates take the operand's value; an EAABS operand whose symbol has attr bit 0 clear becomes the immediate address (EAIMM, opnd_class 2/3); @Rn / @(0,Rn) not on the frame become the register (EAREGD); otherwise the template aamper002 (00455488, absolute) or aamper001 (00455418) is run (00424c80); an IL_ID operand goes to 0042fe80 afterwards

name: prepare_member_node
note: PARAMS: the // sig line says (void) but the body reads a stack parameter (004031a2 MOV ESI,[ESP+0xc]); one parameter. Late handler of IL_QUALIFY (index 8, struct member access). Generates the base operand; for a memory use (usage 3) of @Rn / @(disp,Rn) whose displacement plus the member offset (node +1c) is beyond the @(disp,Rn) range (> 15 byte, > 30 word, > 60 long, float on FPU targets) runs aqual001 (00455358) / aqual002 (004553b8) to get the address into a register and addresses @(R0,Rn) (EAINDEX); otherwise takes the operand's value ea and adds the member offset to its disp; aggregate results become the address immediate or are marked with ea bit 0x40

name: prepare_bit_field_node
note: PARAMS: the // sig line says (void) but the body reads a stack parameter (004034e2 MOV ESI,[ESP+0xc]); one parameter. Late handler of IL_B_QUALIFY (index 9). Copies bit_offset / bit_width (node +01 / +04) into desc +04 / +05, takes the template 00430490 picks (00431950), generates the containing operand with pref_regs 4, flags2 |= 0x10; non-memory uses run the template (00424c80); memory uses (usage 3) pass the bit fields to the parent (an IL_ASSIGN parent takes the operand's address + member offset) or run the template and keep a copy of the value in saved_ea +60 (r2 @(disp) when the template has flag 0x20)

name: prepare_cast_node
note: late handler of IL_CAST (index 0; the index table also maps ops 0x03..0x1f to it but only 0x20..0x7f are dispatched). Compares operand and result sizes (0042b820): a narrowing cast of a memory operand reads it in place (disp adjusted by the size difference unless request +0x2a), conversions select the cast templates through g_cast_select (00422180 / 00423410 + 00424c80, flags7 |= 0x02), a constant operand is folded (0040ba90), a same-size cast forwards the destination like prepare_unary_plus_node. An operand of an IL_MUL parent with short/char operand types may take the operand's type (00421e00)

name: prepare_identifier_node
note: PARAMS: the // sig line says (void) but the body reads a stack parameter (004042e2 MOV ESI,[ESP+0xc]); one parameter. Late handler of IL_ID (index 44). A variable cached in a scratch register (004300d0) uses it (EAREGD; reg_content flag 0x80, reused_regs). lreg 0x8000: r15 (0x1f / 0x2e for the FPU modes). Other lreg: the ea of its g_lreg_table record (+0x18 of the 0x24-byte entry). Otherwise the symbol's storage ea (sym_entry +20; class 2 sets sym flags 0x08); functions (0x48) become immediate addresses, with request->pic loaded by template aid001 (004552f8), and a built-in (sym flags 0x10) used other than as a callee reports 0x7e4; EAABS operands may reuse an address cached in a register (0042ff60). opnd_class 1 for a register, else 3

name: prepare_constant_node
note: late handler of IL_CONST (index 45). Pointer constant with a symbol (type 0x40, val2 != 0): EAIMM with an 8-byte label_ref of symbol val2 + 0xb6, opnd_class 3; float (0x30): ea type 0xe with both words; else EAIMM val, opnd_class 2. flags3 |= 0x80. Then, unless the parent's template takes the immediate itself (template flags2 0x40 / 0x20 / 0x10 by operand position) or it is the right operand of IL_ADD / IL_SUB with an immediate or register left operand, reuses a register already holding the constant (0042ff60) as its value (EAREGD) and updates busy/temp/reused masks; g_content_hit is restored afterwards

name: new_label_operand
note: 19 calls (00404b90, 00404dd0, 00404ed0, 004053a0, 00411910, 00412390, 004141b0, 00426d00, 004297f0, 00429990, 00429b80, 00429d60): alloc_zeroed(8) label_ref filled with labno (0042b1c0(ref, labno, 0)), returns 004213a0(EAIMM 7, 0xff, 0xff, 0, 0, ref): the operand of JUMP / JUMPT / JUMPF / CALL records. Fatal 0xbcd with g_msg_* on allocation failure. param_1 was undefined2 (2 bytes kept)

name: emit_logical_and_or_node
note: emission handler of IL_AND / IL_OR (g_emit_handler_by_op entries 0x68 / 0x69). Emits both operands (emit_node_code); unless handled in place (flags3 0x80): usage 1 places the left operand's label (true for IL_OR, false for IL_AND) as a LABEL record (g_psd_record, 0042b0e0, 0042ab90); usage 2 (value) emits MOVI of g_ea_imm1 / g_ea_imm0 to the value, JUMP to a new label (new_label_operand), the other label, MOVI of the other constant, the new label; other usages place the label when the parent's op differs

name: emit_comma_node
note: PARAMS: the // sig line says (void) but the body reads a stack parameter (00404d91 MOV ESI,[ESP+8]); one parameter. Emission handler of IL_COMMA (entry 0x6c): emit_node_code on the first operand and on its next sibling (NULL when there is no first operand)

name: emit_conditional_node
note: emission handler of IL_COND (entry 0x7f, ?:). Emits the condition and the second operand, a JUMP (0x24) to a new end label, the condition's false label (first operand desc +0e) with g_cur_sptravel / g_max_sp_travel reset to their values before the second operand, the third operand (004335f0(node, 3)), the end label; g_max_sp_travel keeps the larger arm

name: emit_comparison_node
note: PARAMS: the // sig line says (void) but the body reads a stack parameter (00404ed7 MOV EBP,[ESP+0x1c]); one parameter. Emission handler of IL_EQ..IL_GE (entries 0x60 / 0x61 / 0x64..0x67). Runs the compare template (00414400); unless handled in place: usage 1 emits JUMPT (0x25) / JUMPF (0x26) to the true or false label (new_label_operand, register cond_regs[0]) by op, operand signedness and float mode (CMP/EQ #0,R0 first for float compares done by a runtime routine); usage 2 (value) materializes T through 00411b40 (XOR #1,R0 variant for the float routine case)

name: emit_logical_not_node
note: PARAMS: the // sig line says (void) but the body reads a stack parameter (00405312 MOV EDI,[ESP+0xc]); one parameter. Emission handler of IL_NOT (entry 0x2c; this is the address entries.tsv records as the only .text pointer that is not a known function entry). Handled in place (flags3 0x80 and 0x08): emits the operand only; else runs the template (00414400) and, for a float operand without SH-4 that has a false label, emits XOR #1,R0 (0x82, g_ea_imm1, g_ea_r0)

name: emit_call_node
note: emission handler of op 0x78 IL_ARG (entry 0x78), the argument list node under an IL_CALL (node->parent is the IL_CALL, parent->child the callee). Built-in calls (desc +06 != 0) write one 0x10 record (0042b110) with the arguments' values and return. Otherwise: reserves the struct return area (ADD #-size,R15, or MOVI + ADD for >= 0x80) or 8 bytes for a double result without FPU, emits the arguments (children 1..n-1) with g_pushing_operands set, moves register arguments into place (0042f500 + emit_template_record_sequence_for_node), emits the call: CALL (0x23) to the runtime label 0x49/0x4a for _builtin_strcmp, a 0x10 record for sym_flags 0x40 callees (004336a0 / 004336e0, error 0x1248), or JSR (0x95) through a register (error 0x1201 for frame-based operands); OP 0x2e for desc fpu_mode_flags 1; pops the pushed bytes (ADD #n,R15, MOVI + ADD for >= 0x80) and records the SP change (00420d10)

name: emit_node_code
note: 16 calls (the emission handlers, 00412390, 00414400, 0041abe0, 0042a180): the emission dispatcher. Skips usage-0 nodes without side effect (flags2 0x40) unless the parent is IL_COMMA; ops outside 0x20..0x7f and missing handlers report 0x11fe. Calls g_emit_handler_by_op[op] (004415a0; 00414400 runs the template for most ops); an IL_ARG of a built-in other than 0x1d goes to 00414400, float multiply-add pairs (flags7 0x80, IL_ADD / IL_A_ADD with FPU) to 0042a180. Afterwards stores the value to dest (00413d80) or the memory result (00413bf0 + 00413d00), branches for condition usage (004141b0) except after , ?: compares && ||, loads a volatile value used for its side effect only (0042f500 + emit_template_record_sequence_for_node), and emits the ADD #8,R15 that drops a pushed 8-byte value (template flag 0x10)

name: alloc_zeroed
note: = shcpep alloc_zeroed 00407890 (same code: size 1..0x400 and a multiple of 4, size-class tables of 32 on g_alloc_size_classes (malloc 0x108), alloc_from_chunks, zero fill; error 0xbcd through 00422100 = shcpep report_compiler_message). 69 calls (read_symbol_table, prepare_constant_node, new_label_operand, 0041b070 for the 0x84 node_desc, ...). Freed by pool_free

name: alloc_from_chunks
note: = shcpep alloc_from_chunks 00407b80 (bump allocation in the class's 0x414-byte chunks, then their free lists, then a new chunk pushed at the head). Only caller alloc_zeroed. head takes alloc_chunk ** (types_proposal.h, shcpep's struct); without it void **

name: pool_new_chunk
note: = shcpep pool_new_chunk 00407c00: malloc(0x414) chunk {next 0, cursor +14, end +414, free list 0, free count 0}. RETURN: Ghidra's sig says void (undefined) but both call sites in alloc_from_chunks use EAX (004069d2 MOV [ESI],EAX; 00406a1c TEST EAX,EAX): it must get the pointer return or the rebuild breaks (shcpep needed the same fix)

name: pool_free
note: = shcpep pool_free 00407c30: finds the size class in g_alloc_size_classes (error 0x12e8 when none) and calls pool_free_in_chunk_list. 29 calls (0041be70 frees the 0x84 node_desc, 004182c0 label lists, 0041e150 ea, ...). param_1 was undefined4 *

name: pool_free_in_chunk_list
note: = shcpep pool_free_in_chunk_list 00407cc0: finds the chunk holding ptr (error 0x12ea), double-free check (0x12eb), pushes ptr on its free list, frees the chunk (0043a610) when all 0x400/size blocks are free again. Only caller pool_free

name: generate_statement
note: 9 callers (generate_if_statement, generate_for_statement, 00407640 DO, 00407860 WHILE, 00407af0 block, 00415ec0, 00420220 SWITCH, 0042a790 labels). Sets g_msg_filn / g_msg_line from the node, writes an OP_LINE (0x1d) psd with a statement kind (IL_BLOCK 0, IF 1, WHILE 2, FOR 3, DO 4, SWITCH 5, GOTO 6, BREAK 7, CONTINUE 8, RETURN 9, expression 10, GLABEL / CLABEL / DLABEL 0xb..0xd; none for IL_EMPTY), then dispatches: IL_BLOCK fold_reg_constraints_into_global_masks, IL_SWITCH 00420220, IL_IF generate_if_statement, IL_FOR generate_for_statement, IL_WHILE 00407860, IL_DO 00407640, IL_RETURN 0042a5b0, IL_BREAK 0042aab0, IL_CONTINUE 0042a930, IL_GOTO 0042a9d0, labels 0042a790; any other op is an expression statement: its tree is read from g_ilb_file (00435480, error 0xce6) and generated (0041abe0). Sets g_last_stmt_jumps; for ops 0x10..0x1b invalidates r0..r3 / fr0..fr3 (0042fcb0(0xf000f)) and on SH-4 resets g_fpscr_pr to 2; sets / clears g_after_break. param_1 was byte *

name: generate_if_statement
note: only caller generate_statement (IL_IF). Reads the condition tree (00435480, error 0xce6) and generates it with a new false label (0041abe0(cond, 0, label)); saves the register contents (00430220; SH-4 PR state 004220a0); drops the first child's operands, reads the then-statement (00433720) and generates it (generate_statement); reads the next record: IL_EMPTY -> LABEL false; else JUMP to a new end label (op 0x24 via 0042af80), LABEL false, invalidate r0..r3 / fr0..fr3, restore the contents (00430320, 004220d0), generate the else statement, LABEL end; pops the saved contents (004303e0, 004220e0) and frees the nodes (004333d0). param_1 was int

name: generate_for_statement
note: only caller generate_statement (IL_FOR). Generates the init expression unless IL_NULL (0x6f), JUMP to a new test label, LABEL body; saves and clears g_break_label / g_continue_label (IL_BREAK 0042aab0 / IL_CONTINUE 0042a930 make them on first use), reads and generates the body (generate_statement), places the continue label if one was made, generates the increment expression, LABEL test, then the condition: IL_NULL -> JUMP body, else 0041abe0(cond, body label, 0); places the break label if made and restores both; invalidates r0..r3 / fr0..fr3 and the SH-4 PR state at the labels. param_1 was int

name: generate_do_statement
note: IL_DO (0x17) case of the statement generator 00406bc0. Makes a new label (0042b1e0) and emits LABEL (0x18) for the loop top; saves and clears g_break_label / g_continue_label; reads the body statement from the .ilb (00433720(g_ilb_file), error 0xce6 at EOF) and generates it (00406bc0); frees the old operands of node->child and sets its op to 0x71, reads the condition tree (00435480(NULL, g_ilb_file)); emits LABEL g_continue_label if a `continue` made one; generates the condition with true_label = the top label (0041abe0(cond, top, 0)); emits LABEL g_break_label if a `break` made one; restores both labels, frees the trees and clears node->child. Invalidates r0..r3/fr0..fr3 contents (0042fcb0(0xf000f)) at each label, resets g_fpscr_pr to 2 on SH-4.

name: generate_while_statement
note: IL_WHILE (0x16) case of 00406bc0. Makes the condition label (also the continue label) and emits JUMP (0x24) to it, with a scratch register from 0041fa30(0,0,0) in psd +03 and 0041bae0 marking it (same sequence as the break / continue generators 0042aab0 / 0042a930); emits LABEL for the body top (second new label); generates the body read from the .ilb (00406bc0); emits LABEL condition; generates the condition read by 00435480 with true_label = body top (0041abe0(cond, top, 0)); emits LABEL g_break_label if used; saves/restores g_break_label (0045ee9c) and g_continue_label (0045fa04). Same tree handling as generate_do_statement (child op set to 0x6f here).

name: generate_block_statement
note: PROPOSED RENAME of fold_reg_constraints_into_global_masks: it is the IL_BLOCK (0x08) case of the statement generator 00406bc0 (the only call). Emits BBGN (0x16) when request +4 (optimize) is 0 and blkflg (node +0x18) bit 0 is clear; saves g_var_gpr_mask / g_var_fpr_mask and adds the registers of the block's sclass-6 symbols whose storage is EAREGD (walks g_symbol_table[node->symx + 0xb6].list_10, 0x10-byte blocks {next, ?, short symx[4]} ending at -1; register < 0x10 general, 0x10..0x1f float single, 0x20.. float pair); generates statements read from the .ilb (00433720 / 00406bc0, freeing node->child each time) until IL_E_BLOCK (0x09); emits a LINE record (0x1d) for the closing brace when the E_BLOCK's grandparent is IL_FUNC; restores the masks; emits BEND (0x17) under the same condition as BBGN. The "fold" is only the register-variable masks (the old name's part).

name: generate_logical_and_node
note: late handler of IL_AND 0x68 (kind 3 -> 0040ec70). Both operands share the node's false_label +0e (a fresh 0042b1e0 label when unset); the right one also gets the true_label; generates left then right with 0040ceb0; invalidates r0..r3 / fr0..fr3 (0042fcb0(0xf000f)) unless the parent is another IL_AND ('h'); both operands constant (opnd_class 2) -> fold with 0040ba90; usage 2 chooses the result register (target_regs or 0041fa30) and regs_2c[0]; SH-4: g_fpscr_pr = 2 when the operands end in different PR states (desc +09). PARAMS: the // sig line says (void) but the code reads the node from its first stack argument (0040ec72 MOV ESI,[ESP+0xc] after two pushes), the dispatcher 0040ceb0 calls it with the node, and the rebuild already has 1 parameter. Mirror of 0040efd0.

name: generate_logical_or_node
note: late handler of IL_OR 0x69 (kind 3 -> 0040efd0): the code of 0040ec70 with true_label +0c and false_label +0e swapped and the parent test against 'i' (IL_OR). PARAMS: the // sig line says (void) but 0040efd2 MOV ESI,[ESP+0xc] reads the node argument (rebuild has 1 parameter).

name: generate_argument_list_node
note: late handler of IL_ARG 0x78 'x' (g_late_handler_index_by_op[0x78] = 46, kind 3 -> 0040f320): the argument list, second child of an IL_CALL, ended by IL_E_ARG 'y'. For a struct-returning call (type kind 0x60) computes the 4-rounded return size and, when > 0x7f, picks the call's regs_34[0]; assigns argument registers (0040f840(args, 0)); generates every argument up to 'y' with 0040ceb0, freeing its target register (target_regs +14) from busy_regs and g_var_gpr_mask while it is generated, summing the 4-rounded sizes of pushed arguments (flags2 0x08); then 0041f450(args, 0) and 0041e280(call, callee, args); SH-4 sets fpu_mode_flags 0x01 and g_fpscr_pr = 2; finally 0040f610(call, pushed bytes, return size). PARAMS: the // sig line says (void) but 0040f325 MOV ESI,[ESP+0x1c] reads the node argument (rebuild has 1 parameter).

name: choose_call_registers
signature: void choose_call_registers(gen_node *call, int pushed_bytes, int return_size)
note: registers of the call sequence. pushed_bytes == -1: recomputed from the IL_ARG children (flags2 0x08, 0042b820 sizes rounded to 4). For struct / non-SH-4 double returns picks the call's regs_34[1] (reusing regs_34[0] when allowed); on the IL_ARG node (call->child->next) picks regs_2c[0] for the callee address unless the callee operand is @Rn or @(0,Rn) without labels, regs_2c[2] / [3] when its fpu_mode_flags bit 0 is set (PR switch around the call), and regs_2c[1] when pushed_bytes + return_size > 0x7f (stack adjustment beyond add #imm). Callers 0040f320 (after the arguments) and 004111e0 (IL_CALL nodes, pushed_bytes -1).

name: assign_argument_registers
note: walks the arguments of an IL_ARG list from child (count - skip - 1) down to child 1 (00433640 / 004335f0) and gives each a register: integer / pointer / array / function (and float without an FPU) the first free of r4..r7 (mask 0xf0, at most 4) in target_regs +14 and g_used_gpr_mask; with an FPU (cpu 4, or cpu 2 with request +0x37 == 3) floats the next free register of the scratch bank (request +0x149 registers from bit 4) in ftarget_regs +22 / g_used_fpr_mask, SH-4 doubles a free pair; the rest (no register left, structs, and positions <= count - call->call_06 when the call's val3 bit 0 is set) get flags2 0x08 (pushed). ORs into each argument's need_regs +32 the next sibling's. skip: 0 from 0040f320, 2 from 0040ff00 (BI_TRAPA_SVC). Evidence for call_06 / val3 bit 0: read here only.

name: check_builtin_immediate_argument
note: for built-ins whose g_builtin_info flags have 0x80 (called by 0040ff00): the argument selected by flags & 7 (7 = the last real one, count - 1) must be a constant (opnd_class 2), else message 0xaf1 and the node becomes IL_CONST 0 (EAIMM #0); its value (desc value.disp +6c) is range-checked: flags 0x20 0..0xff, 0x10 0..0x1fe and even, otherwise 0..0x3fc and a multiple of 4 (the @(disp,GBR) byte / word / long ranges); message 0xaf2 out of range, 0xaf3 misaligned; the masked value is written back with 0042b180 when it changed.

name: check_trapa_svc_arguments
note: only when the IL_ARG node's builtin (desc +06) is 0x1c (BI_TRAPA_SVC): needs 2..6 arguments (message 0xaf0); below 2 prepends IL_CONST nodes of type 0x10 (00433580(0x71), fresh 0x84-byte descriptor with the slot bytes set to 0xff as 0041b070 does, usage 2, 004335c0); the last two arguments must be signed int (type & 0xf8 == 0x10), the others int / float / pointer / function, else message 0xaf1 and the type byte is forced to 0x10. The stock code clears args +0x18 instead of the new node's (kept for byte identity). Caller 0040ff00.

name: generate_call_node
note: RENAME (was finalize_x_node_from_child_chain): this is the late handler of IL_CALL 0x30 (g_late_handler_index_by_op[0x30] = 7, kind 3 -> 0040ff00), not of 'x' (IL_ARG 0x78 maps to 46 -> 0040f320); the old notes confused handler index 7 with op 'x'. builtin (desc +06) 0 -> 00410eb0. Otherwise copies the builtin into the IL_ARG node (child 2); BI_ASM 0x1d (operand must be IL_CONST, message 0x1239) clobbers all scratch registers; built-ins the cpu lacks give message 0xaf4 (0x1a/0x1b on SH-1, 0x1e below SH-3, the SH-4 vector built-ins 0x21/0x23..0x2f by cpu, request +0x37 and +0x157) or warning 0x7e4 with the callee name (0x1f/0x20, 0x30/0x31) and fall back to an ordinary call; selects the template (00410890(1, args)) into the IL_ARG desc +80 and removes its clobbers (+31) from busy_regs; TRAPA_SVC: 0040fca0, 0040f840(args, 2), target r0 for its second-last argument (child count - 2); marks the operand the template names (tmpl flags2 0x40 / 0x20 / 0x10) with flags7 0x40; 00431950; generates the arguments (0040ceb0); per builtin: 0041e280 / 0041f6a0 / 0041f450 and the temp_regs of the operands; 0040faa0 when g_builtin_info flags 0x80, 00410890(0, args) again when 0x40; 00424c80 on the IL_ARG node; MACW..MACLL (0x18..0x1b) take r4..r7 out of g_var_gpr_mask and record the slot registers to save in saved_regs +10; usage 2 of GBR_TST_BYTE 0x10 / TAS 0x14 gives the value r0 / regs_2c[0]; usage 1 of those picks cond_regs[0] +38; copies value / opnd_class / masks up; invalidates register contents (0042fdb0 or 0042fcb0); always sets flags3 0x80 | 0x08.

name: select_builtin_template
note: returns one of the candidate templates g_builtin_info[builtin].templates[0..2] (the ainlin* family) for the IL_ARG node's builtin (desc +06). before_operands 1 (first call in 0040ff00) decides from the IL shape (an IL_CONST 'q' / IL_ID 'p' argument); 0 (after the arguments were generated, g_builtin_info flags 0x40) from the generated operands: opnd_class of the first / second argument, a small label-free EAIMM count < 0x21 for MACW..MACLL (0x18..0x1b), and for STRCPY 0x16 a string-literal source (sclass 9, length <= 0x20 / 0x80, request +0x20 set) with a 4-byte-aligned destination (frame 'l' disp or a static / extern symbol's frame_offset) and the call's usage. Ghidra return undefined4: stored in desc +80 by 0040ff00.

name: generate_ordinary_call
note: IL_CALL without a builtin (0040ff00 when desc +06 == 0): reserves a frame temporary for a struct result when nothing else holds it (00420140 with the size at node +18); generates the callee (child 1) and the IL_ARG list (child 2) with 0040ceb0; the value is r0 (integers / pointers), fr0 (float with an FPU), fr0-fr1 (SH-4 double) or memory (opnd_class 3, structs / soft doubles); then marks the call-clobbered registers: temp_regs low byte 0xff (r0..r7) and ftemp_regs fr0..fr3 plus the scratch bank (on the enclosing IL_ASSIGN '_' instead when it assigns the result), g_used_gpr_mask |= 0xff, g_used_fpr_mask, 0042fcb0(0xf000f), g_r0_used = 1.

name: reselect_value_template
note: re-chooses the template (desc +80) of a double / struct / array right-hand side that IL_ASSIGN's handler 0040d9e0 gave a new destination (its only caller, after 0041e280), with the late-handler kinds of 0040ceb0: kind 1 / 2 via 00423410, kind 4 via 004113d0; IL_ASSIGN '_' of an aggregate 00430ff0(node, 1), of a double the selector g_assign_double_select or g_assign_double_select_alt (request +0x2a); IL_CAST ' ' g_cast_double_select; IL_CALL '0' 0040f610(node, -1, 0); other ops message 0x1222; then 00424c80 with the new template.

name: select_cpu_variant
note: walks a kind-4 late handler list (8-byte entries {condition bits, kind, pad, pointer}, ended by bits 0) and takes the first entry all of whose bits hold (1 cpu != 0, 2 request +0x20 != 0, 4 cpu == 0, 8 cpu > 1: enum cpu_variant_cond); kind 1 stores the pointer in *unary_out and returns 1, otherwise in *binary_out and returns 0 (low 16 bits; the high half is the out pointer's). Callers 0040ceb0 and 004111e0 test (short) == 0.

name: emit_shift_by_constant
signature: void emit_shift_by_constant(ea *reg, char kind, int count)
note: emits psd shifts of reg by count, largest steps first: kind 1 logical right (SHLR16 0x5d, SHLR8 0x5c, SHLR2 0x5b, SHLR 0x5a), kind 2 left (the same codes + 0xf0 as a byte: SHLL16 0x4d, SHLL8 0x4c, SHLL2 0x4b, SHLL 0x4a), other kinds arithmetic right: count x SHAR 0x59; each through 00421410 with a copy of reg (0042b730). Callers 00411690, 00411d00, 00412390 (macro 0x900).

name: emit_right_shift_by_constant
signature: void emit_right_shift_by_constant(ea *reg, int count, char logical)
note: right shift by a constant (template macro 0x1100). logical 1: count < 0x1d -> 004114e0(reg, 1, count); 0x1d..0x1f -> (33 - count) x ROTL 0x4e then AND #((1 << (32 - count)) - 1). Arithmetic: < 16 -> SHAR x count; 16..23 -> SHAR x (count - 16), SHLR16, EXTS.W 0x7b; 24..28 -> SHAR x (count - 24), SHLR16, SHLR8, EXTS.B; 31 -> ROTL, SUBC 0x64 Rn,Rn; 29 / 30 emit nothing (macro 0x2000 covers them). 00412390 passes logical 0 for IL_DIV / IL_A_DIV and signed operands.

name: emit_sar_r0_by_rotation
note: template macro 0x2000: arithmetic right shift of r0 by a large count using rotates: ROTL r0 (sign into T); JUMPT L1; (31 - count) x ROTL; AND #((1 << (32 - count)) - 1),r0; JUMP L2; L1: (31 - count) x ROTL; OR #((-1 << (31 - count)) & 0xff),r0; EXTS.B r0,r0; L2 (labels from 0042b1e0; the LABEL records go through g_out_psd / 0042ab90 with g_sp_travel). hint: only its register byte (+01) is used, as the jump records' register argument.

name: emit_movt_result
note: MOVT 0x42 into reg; when t_is_value is 0 inverts the 0/1 result: XOR #1,r0 (0x82) when reg is r0, else ADD #-1,Rn (0x60) and NEG Rn,Rn (0x78). node is not read (both callers pass the node). Callers 00404ed0 (comparison results) and 00412390 macro 0x1000.

name: psd_size_code_of_node
note: byte size of the node's type (0042b820) as a psd operand size code: 1 -> 0 (byte), 2 -> 1 (word), else 2 (long). Returns a byte (MOV AL,2 / XOR AL,AL / MOV AL,1); every caller uses only the low byte (00404b90 MOV CL,AL; 0041db10 stores (char); 00412390 MOV [ESP+0x17],AL).

name: collect_macro_operand_list
note: reads the 0x2200 entries (operand list) that follow a macro, materializing opnd[0] / opnd[1] (when not 0xfa) with materialize_operand_record_from_descriptor into out[]; stops at the first non-0x2200 entry or after an entry that produced an operand; returns the number of entries read (the caller skips them). Callers 00411fe0, 00412200, 00412390 (macros 0x2100, 0x2400..0x2e00), 004297f0, 00429990, 00429b80, 00429d60.

name: free_macro_operand_list
note: frees list[0] with 0041e150 (the ea and its label list); a loop whose count is the constant 1. Pairs with 00411c30 in the same callers.

name: count_leading_bits_equal
signature: int count_leading_bits_equal(int value, int max_bits, int bit)
note: how many leading bits of value (from bit 31, at most max_bits) equal bit (0 or 1). Only caller 00411d00. PARAMS: the // sig line says (void) but the code reads three stack arguments (00411cd3 [ESP+0xc], 00411cdc [ESP+0xc], 00411ce0 [ESP+0x14] after two pushes) and the caller pushes three; the rebuild already has (int, int, int).

name: expand_multiply_by_constant
signature: int expand_multiply_by_constant(unsigned int multiplier, ea *dest, ea **source, short emit)
note: shift-and-add expansion of dest = *source * multiplier (template macro 0x2100 with emit 1; 00423800 with emit 0, only to cost it): MOVI #0 or MOV source,dest, then the runs of ones / zeros (00411cd0) become left shifts (004114e0 kind 2) with ADD 0x60 / SUB 0x63 of the source, NEG for a negative multiplier; counts instructions (00430d80 per shift) and returns 1 in the low 16 bits when the count is <= 25 (45 when multiplier > 0xffff), else 0; 00423800 tests (short).

name: emit_single_bit_field_store
note: template macros 0x2f00 / 0x3000 / 0x3100: store a constant into a one-bit field of a byte / word / long: bit 0 of value's disp picks OR (set) with the bit immediate (operand codes 0x99 / 0x9c / 0x9d: OPIMM_BIT_IN_BYTE / WORD / LONG) or AND (clear) with the hole mask (0xa1 / 0xa2 / 0xa3: OPIMM_HOLE_MASK_BYTE / WORD / LONG); the word and long forms first MOVI the immediate into the temporary of the following 0x2200 list (00411c30). value = the entry's opnd[0] materialized by 00412390. Returns the entries consumed.

name: emit_push_double_one
note: template macro 0x100: pushes the double 1.0 (g_double_one_hi 0x3ff00000, g_double_one_lo 0) on the stack through the temporary of the following 0x2200 list: MOVI #word,tmp ; MOV tmp,@-R15 twice, low word first (high word at the lower address) unless request +0x2a is set. Returns the entries consumed (00411c30).

name: emit_template_record_sequence_for_node
note: the template interpreter: walks the 12-byte tmpl_entry list until op 0xff00. Skips an entry by its flags (0x01 type conditions of 0x300 / 0x1600 / 0x1700 / 0x4200, 0x10 only unsigned / pointer / array, 0x20 only bit_width != 32, 0x40 / 0x80 usage 2 / 3 of the node or, for an IL_ARG 'x' node, of its call; 0x02 swaps the operands when the first is r0; 0x08 adds the first operand's disp to g_sp_travel via 00420d10). Operands are materialized with 0041c200 (operands = the 7 extra ea slots, the g_template_extra_operands layout; nested runs pass their own 7-slot array). Plain psd ops go out with 00421410 (size from 00411c10 or, for built-in IL_ARG nodes, from the builtin; GBR operands flagged 0x80); 0x23 CALL takes opnd[0] 0xfe..0x105 as computed runtime routines (0041d1a0, 0041d080, 0041d050, 0041cfa0, 0041ced0); 0x24..0x26 JUMP / JUMPT / JUMPF and 0x18 LABEL use the template's labels (004320a0). Macro ops, see enum tmpl_macro in types_proposal.h: 0x100 push 1.0 (00412200); 0x200 / 0x500 ALU op by IL op, 0x300 / 0x1600 / 0x1700 / 0x4200 EXTS / EXTU, 0x400 MULS / MULU / MUL.L, 0x600 relational CMP, 0x700 / 0x800 CMP/PZ-PL, 0x2300 SHAD / SHLD (0041db10 maps each to a psd op); 0x900 shift left (004114e0); 0xa00 / 0xb00 emit one / both operands (00406340, 00413bf0); 0xc00..0xf00, 0x1b00, 0x1c00, 0x2700, 0x2800, 0x2b00 a nested template from 0042f500 (kinds 1 / 3 / 4 / 2 / 4 / 2 / 1 / 2 / 1, with type overrides; 0x1b00 for an in-memory value uses g_tmpl_apusha005) run recursively on the operand node; 0x1000 MOVT result (00411b40); 0x1100 right shift (00411690); 0x1d00 SHLL / SHLL2 by builtin; 0x1e00 MAC sequence (004146a0); 0x1f00 argument register loads (004147f0); 0x2000 (00411910); 0x2100 multiply by constant (00411d00); 0x2200 operand list (data); 0x2400 / 0x2500 / 0x2600 / 0x2a00 block copies (00414900); 0x2c00 (00415030); 0x2d00 (004294f0); 0x2e00 (00429590); 0x2f00..0x3100 one-bit field store (00411fe0); 0x3200 / 0x3500 (00429600 mode 0 / 1); 0x3300 (004297f0), 0x3400 (00429b80), 0x4300 (00429990), 0x4400 (00429d60); 0x3600 (00429770); 0x3700 (00429f90); 0x3800 / 0x3900 FPSCR switch (psd op 0x2e size 2 / 3 when fpu_mode_flags bit 0 / 1 says so); 0x3a00 (00429ff0); 0x4100 (0042a0b0); unknown macros fall to the plain-op path. Callers 004053a0, 00406340, 00413bf0, 00413d00, 00413d80, 004141b0, 00414400, 004147f0, 0042a180 and itself. Ghidra-now return void (the rebuild's byte * is a leftover).

name: load_slot_register_operands
note: clears operands[2..6] and fills them with EAREGD ea records (004213a0(1, reg, ...)) of the node's slot registers that are not 0xff: kind 1 regs_41[0..2] + regs_44[0..1], 2 regs_3d[0..1], 3 reg_47, 4 addr_reg +46; other kinds message 0x1200. Pairs with 00413b10 around a nested template run (004053a0, 00413bf0, 00413d00, 00413d80, 004147f0).

name: free_slot_register_operands
note: frees (0041e150) what 00413930 made for the same kind: kind 1 operands[2..6], 2 [2..3], 3 / 4 [2]; other kinds message 0x1237.

name: load_node_address_register
note: when the node has an address register operand (desc addr_reg_ea +58): pops it (MOV @R15+,Rn) when the value was pushed (flags2 0x08), else runs the move template (0042f500 kind 0; type forced to pointer '@' for usage 3 or flags3 0x20) from dest +74 into it with the kind-4 slot operand. Callers 004053a0, 00406340, 00412390 (macro 0xb00), 00414400 (between operands), 0042a180.

name: store_node_value_through_address
note: runs the move template (0042f500 kind 0) from the node's value +68 to its mem_ea +5c with the kind-1 slot operands; 00406340 calls it right after 00413bf0 for nodes whose value goes to memory through an address register (flags3 0x20).

name: move_node_result_to_destination
note: after a node's code (caller 00406340): restores the saved value +60 into its register copy +64 (or pushes it to @-R15 when flags3 0x10); then either moves value +68 to dest +74 (type taken from the parent with flags3 0x02, pointer for arrays), or into the target register (target_regs via 0041c180 / ftarget_regs via 00430f30), or pushes it (flags2 0x04 / 0x08: 0042f500 kind 6 to @-R15, then kind 3 for the second half of an 8-byte push), each through a nested template with slot operands (00413930 / 00413b10).

name: emit_branch_on_node_value
note: a value used as a condition (usage 1, not a comparison / AND / OR / COND / COMMA; caller 00406340): a constant (opnd_class 2) becomes a JUMP to true_label +0c or false_label +0e by whether it is nonzero (00428910); otherwise runs a test-against-zero entry list chosen by type and operand class (g_test_*_entries: TST after EXTU / a load / SHLL for software float, FPU sequences for float / double; SH-4 sets fpu_mode_flags 0x04) and emits JUMPF (T clear after TST: nonzero) to the true label or JUMPT to the false label (the two swapped for BI_TAS); cond_regs[0] +38 is the jump records' register argument.

name: emit_node_operands_and_template
note: emits a node through its chosen template (desc +80): unless flags3 0x80, emits the operands in order (reversed with flags2 0x80) with 00406340 (g_nested_operand_emit set when the template pushes operands, tmpl +30), loading address registers (00413bf0) between them; pushes saved_regs +10 (MOV Rn,@-R15, r15 downwards), runs emit_template_record_sequence_for_node with zeroed extra operands (g_mark_template_records = 1 and the value register added to g_stmt_invalidate_mask for tmpl flags 0x01 when the value stays in a register), then pops the saved registers (MOV @R15+,Rn upwards); no template: message 0x11fd. Callers 00404ed0, 00405310, 00406340 (IL_ARG nodes of built-ins other than BI_ASM).

name: emit_mac_builtin_records
signature: void emit_mac_builtin_records(int builtin, int count, ea *left, ea *right, ea *mask)
note: the macw/macwl/macl/macll built-ins (builtin_fn 0x18..0x1b, desc +06; caller 00412390 passes (int)desc->builtin, the count from an operand desc value.disp +6c, and three operands from 0041c200): turns left/right (@Rn) into @Rn+ (type & 0xf4 | 4) and emits count x psd 0x72 MAC (size 1 = .w for 0x18/0x19, 2 = .l for 0x1a/0x1b) through 00421410; the ring-buffer forms 0x19/0x1b also emit AND mask,copy-of-right (psd 0x80) after each MAC; frees the ea records with 0041e150

name: emit_operand_moves_to_target_registers
note: template macro 0x1f00 (caller 00412390 passes 1): for operands count-skip-1 down to 1 (00433640 count, 004335f0 n-th) whose desc target_regs +14 is set and that have a dest +74 or are pushed (flags2 0x08 -> g_ea_pop), makes a register ea of the target (00430f00 mask -> register, 004213a0), gets a move template from 0042f500 and runs its entries with emit_template_record_sequence_for_node (operand list from 00413930(4, ..), freed by 00413b10); the call-argument register loads

name: emit_block_copy_macro
signature: void emit_block_copy_macro(unsigned short op, ea *src, ea *dst, ea **temps, ea *dst_addr, gen_node *node)
note: template macros 0x2400 / 0x2500 / 0x2600 / 0x2a00 (caller 00412390 passes the entry op word, two operands from 0041c200, the temporary-register ea array filled by 00411c30, the destination address ea (node value +68 by default) and the node): copies node->val (+18, aggregate size) bytes as MOV @src+,tmp / MOV tmp,@dst / ADD #n,dst (psd 0x40 / 0x60 via 00421410): 0x2400 by element unit (1/2/4 from the type), 0x2a00 the long-aligned part (size rounded down to 4), 0x2500 the 1/2 leading bytes that align the destination (address = frame disp, or g_symbol_table[label].frame_offset + disp), 0x2600 the remainder. op is 2 bytes as Ghidra had it (unsigned: the tmpl_entry op words)

name: emit_symbol_sized_block_copy
note: template macro 0x2c00 (caller 00412390): byte count = g_symbol_table[|node->child->symx + 0xb6|].list_10 (the int that class-9 symbols keep there, 00401000), copied when <= 0x80; by longs (unit 4) when the source operand of child->next (mem_ea +5c / dest +74 / g_ea_pop / value +68) is a 4-aligned frame address or a 4-aligned symbol (sclass 1/3/4/9: frame_offset + disp), else by bytes; same MOV/MOV/ADD records as emit_block_copy_macro, then the 2/1 byte tail. What the class-9 symbol is (an initializer?) is not established

name: allocate_static_variables_and_write_sud
note: shcgen_main step after 00401000: points the .sud buffer cursor/start (0045f9f4 / 0045fe64) at 0045eeb0, 00408970, then for every present (flags 0x80), not yet placed (0x40) symbol with byte_03 0, sclass 1/3/4 and type not 0x48/0x50 writes to the .sud file 0045f9f0: a 0x0f record + section id when the symbol's section (short_06, looked up by 004201e0) changes, and for symbols without a register (reg -1) a 0x18 record {symbol number, 4 zero bytes, {9 or 10 by attr & 3, unit class 0/1/2}, count} after write_sud_alignment_padding; stores the section counter (+0x10 for attr & 3, else +0x14) in sym frame_offset and advances it by the size (0xc81 overflow, 0x1234 / 0x1235 bad type); writes the .asa symbol (00407d80(9, sym)) and sets flags 0x40

name: write_sud_alignment_padding
signature: void write_sud_alignment_padding(int unit_class, unsigned int *offset, unsigned int symno)
note: caller allocate_static_variables_and_write_sud: aligns the section counter *offset for a variable of unit class 0/1/2 (byte/word/long), to 8 when g_symbol_table[symno & 0xffff].attr & 0x40, else to 2 (class 1) or 4 (class 2): writes {0x0a, unit 0/1/2} + count-1 pad records to the .sud file 0045f9f0 and advances *offset; 0x1236 bad case, 0xc81 overflow

name: generate_ilb_stream

name: emit_psd_instruction
signature: void emit_psd_instruction(unsigned short op, char tmp, char flag_20, unsigned char size, unsigned char misc, ea *src, ea *dst)
note: Writes one psd record (g_psd_record via 0042af80, then 0042ab90) with expno g_stmt_serial, g_msg_filn/line, sptravel g_sptravel: drops no-ops (MOV / macros 0x1200..0x1400 with ea_operands_equal operands, ADD #0, OR #0); sets the size field per op (byte/word/long rules for MOV, extensions, logic ops, floating ops 0xb0..0xdd); turns macros 0x1200/0x1300/0x1400 into MOV 0x40 and 0x1800/0x1900/0x1a00 into MOV_LOC 0x27 with size 0/1/2; size |= 0x80 for volatile operands, 0x20 when flag_20 == 1; misc |= 0x80 for MOV_LOC from a register, 0x20 while g_template_value_unused; CALL to a runtime routine (label <= 0xb6): clears g_current_aux_record +0a bit 0x8000, sets the routine's bit at +2c, and update_stack_travel(1, g_routine_stack_adjust[label]) (skipped on cpu 4); other ops update_stack_travel(0, 0, &g_psd_record). Callers 004053a0, emit_psd_for_node 00421410.

name: new_ea_operand_with_flags
signature: ea *new_ea_operand_with_flags(unsigned char kind, char base, char index, int disp, unsigned char type_flags, label_ref *labels)
note: Allocates a 0xc ea (00406830; error 0xbcd -> NULL) and fills it with 0042b180(type = kind | type_flags, base, index, misc 0, disp, labels). Differs from shcpep new_ea_operand 0040b100 (extra flags argument, misc). 17 callers (00414400 passes (1, reg, 0xff, 0, flags, labels)).

name: emit_psd_for_node
signature: void emit_psd_for_node(unsigned short op, char tmp, char flag_20, unsigned char size, ea *src, ea *dst, gen_node *node)
note: When node is volatile (type & 2) or its dest +74 is volatile (0x80): marks memory operands (EAIDREG / EADISP) of src/dst volatile; misc = 0x40 for MOV_LOC 0x27 / macros 0x1800..0x1a00 of an unsigned/pointer/array node; then emit_psd_instruction(op, tmp, flag_20, size, misc, src, dst). ~32 callers (template entries, pushes, moves).

name: protect_fmac_operand_registers
note: For the 3 multiply-add operands (operands[2] down to [0]): propagates flags2 0x02, cached/reused masks, frame_low, flags3 0x01 into node; an operand whose value register is clobbered by the operands generated after it (or whose FR0set (+20 bit 0) is clear while it sits in fr0) is moved to a new floating register (choose_float_register, macro 0xc00) or pushed (@-R15, flags2 0x08, g_stmt_pushed_operand); memory operands also get an address register (choose_general_register, +58/+5c @(0,Rn)). Sets node busy_regs / fbusy_regs. Caller 00421890.

name: generate_float_multiply_add
note: Float multiply-add (desc flags7 0x80, 0040ceb0): finds the IL_MUL operand and the addend, sets their fpref (fr0 for the multiplicand by FR0set, any (0xe) for the rest), orders the three operands (by side effects), generates them in order (dispatch_and_finalize_code_node, copying busy/fbusy/frame_top/flags7 0x40), protect_fmac_operand_registers, then puts each operand in a floating register into regs_2c[0..2] (fr0 for the FR0set operand, the result register from dest / ftarget_regs / choose_float_register), value +68 = the result register, a memory destination gets a 0xf00 store; on SH-4 with PR tracking and g_fpscr_pr != 0 chooses two general registers into regs_2c[3] / [4] and sets fpu_mode_flags 0x01. Caller 0040ceb0.

name: is_16bit_multiplier_constant
note: 1 when node is an IL_CONST (op 0x71) whose val (+18) fits 16 bits (-0x8000..0x7fff, or 0..0xffff when is_unsigned) AND is not cheap by shifts: 0041c180 (index of the single set bit, -1 if not a power of two) rejects 2^n, 2^n-1 (val+1 tested) and 2^n+1 (val-1 tested); 0041c120(val, 1) rejects two-bit values 2^a+2^b. So it answers "this constant operand needs a real 16-bit multiply (muls.w / mulu.w)". Callers: 00421ea0 (is_unsigned = the other operand's type & 4 or kind 0x80 / 0x40), 004037e0 (same test on a cast's operand type). Callers test the full int

name: mul_fits_16bit_multiply
note: For an IL_MUL node: 1 when the multiply can be done 16x16->32 (muls.w / mulu.w). Operands are child +10 and child->next +14; an operand is "16-bit" when it is an IL_CAST (0x20) of a char / short value (the cast child's type & 0xf8 == 0 or 8). Returns 1 when both are 16-bit casts of the same signedness (unsigned = type & 4 or kind 0x80 / 0x40); when the signedness differs and neither side is an unsigned short; or when one side is a 16-bit cast and the other an IL_CONST that is_16bit_multiplier_constant 00421e00 accepts (with the cast's signedness). Callers: 004293c0 nested-selector condition 1 (node op 'D' 0x44 && 00421ea0) picks the 16-bit amul templates; 0041db10 (op 0x400 multiply, int operands). Not strength reduction: the shift-and-add constants are the ones it rejects

name: push_fpscr_pr_state
note: Allocates an 8-byte record (00406830(8)): +0 next = g_fpscr_pr_stack (0045f984), +4 byte = g_fpscr_pr (0045f9f8), and makes it the head. The SH-4 FPSCR.PR counterpart of 00430220 (push of the r0..r3 contents): 0040e050 / 00420220 call it next to 00430220 under (request cpu == 4 && request +0x157 == 0); also 00406ed0

name: restore_fpscr_pr_state
note: g_fpscr_pr = byte +4 of the g_fpscr_pr_stack head, without popping (counterpart of 00430320, which restores the register contents: 0040e050 calls both before generating its second branch; 0042a790 after a switch / label jump); also 00406ed0

name: pop_fpscr_pr_state
note: Unlinks the g_fpscr_pr_stack head and frees it (00406a70(rec, 8)); called next to 004303e0 (pop of the register contents) by 0040e050 (which then sets g_fpscr_pr = 2, unknown) and 00420220; also 00406ed0

name: report_compiler_message
signature: void report_compiler_message(short filno, unsigned int linno, short msgno, char *text)
note: = shcpep report_compiler_message 00410e90 (same code: finds filno in g_loaded_request->source_files (+0xec), calls 00439910 (= shcpep report_message_by_code) with (name, linno & 0xffff, msgno, text); msgno >= 3000: 00439750 (= shcpep close_and_delete_temp_files) then exit 0043a780(9), or 11 when msgno >= 4000). About 26 callers: the allocator 00406830 / 00406a70 / 00406b00, the .ofa writers 00419d00..0041a7f0, 004201e0, 0042a510, 0042baa0, 00432430 ...

name: generate_operator_by_template
note: Generator for late handlers of kind 1 / 2 (dispatch_and_finalize_code_node 0040ceb0 passes g_late_handler_table[i] and operand_count 1 or 2; also 00401c90 (unary, 1) and 004037e0 (IL_CAST, 00447e58, 2)). Steps: provisional template by operand constness (00423410(..., by_constness 1) when desc +80 is empty; its result says it must be redone); 00431950 operand preferences; copies busy_regs / fbusy_regs / frame_top / flags7 0x40 into the left operand (removing tmpl clobbers +31 from its busy_regs; pref_regs = r0 when the result feeds an IL_ASTER address) and generates it with dispatch_and_finalize_code_node, then the right one the same way; two IL_CASTs of the same 16-bit unsigned type under a comparison (0x60..0x67) set flags7 0x02 and type |= 4 on both; both operands constant (opnd_class 2) -> 0040ba90 folds and returns; IL_CAST -> 00431ed0 shortcut; 0041e280; assignment operators (0x38..0x3d PRI..POD, 0x50..0x5f A_ops / ASSIGN) whose left operand is EAABS (0x0d) of a non-GBR symbol (attr & 3 == 0): load the address into a register (cached content via 0042ff60, else the chooser 0041fa30 avoiding tmpl excluded +34), set desc +58 / +5c (@(0,Rn)) and flags3 0x04; IL_ADD / IL_SUB -> 00417ed0; operands loaded through r0 (0040d690) -> spills 0041e740 / 0041eef0 (tmpl spill_mask +35) or a move to r0 via 00429060; target / pref register bookkeeping (opnd_class 1 when an operand already sits in the target); reselect (00423410) when anything changed; apply_template_to_node 00424c80(node, tmpl, 0x10, 0, 0, 00432110(node), node); IL_B_AND with usage 1 then sets flags2 0x20 / flags7 0x01

name: select_node_template
signature: short select_node_template(gen_node *node, tmpl_select *select, char operand_count, char by_constness, tmpl_header **out)
note: Picks node's code template into *out (callers pass &desc->tmpl, +80). operand_count 1: choice = select->choice[class] (class = operand_type_class 004236b0 of the node, or of its first operand for IL_COMMA and comparisons 0x60..0x67); 2: choice[left * 5 + right] (left = first operand's class, right = second operand's, or the node's own type for IL_CAST). choice.how 1: *out = targets[index]; 3: nested selector 004293c0 (cpu / FPU / 16-bit multiply conditions); otherwise a tmpl_matrix (targets[index]) indexed by the operands' opnd_class (desc +01), or with by_constness 1 by 2 = IL_CONST / 3 = other; a column of -1 is computed by select_matrix_column 00423800 from matrix +08 starting at the pair's second byte. Error 0x1228 (no choice / negative column). Returns 1 when a matrix was used in by_constness mode (provisional: 00422180 reselects after generating the operands), else 0 or 004293c0's value. Callers 00401f30, 004037e0, 0040d9e0, 004111e0, 00422180 (only 00422180 uses the result)

name: operand_type_class
note: Type class of node->type (+05) & 0xf8 for the template selectors: 0 / 8 (char, short) -> 0; 0x10 / 0x18 (int, long) -> 1; 0x40 / 0x48 / 0x80 / 0x88 / 0x90 -> 2 (pointer / array / function kinds); 0x28 -> 3 (float); 0x30 / 0x38 -> 4 (double / long double); anything else error 0x1226. Only caller 00423410 (index into tmpl_select choices); matches the class list in types.h tmpl_select

name: select_matrix_column
signature: unsigned char select_matrix_column(gen_node *operand, unsigned char *rules, char first)
note: Walks {condition, column} byte pairs of a tmpl_matrix rule list (+08) from pair index first; returns the column of the first pair whose condition holds (condition 0xff = always). The tested value is the operand's constant (IL_CONST val +18, or for opnd_class 2 the disp of its mem_ea +5c / dest +74 / value +68); the parent is operand->parent (+0c). Conditions (codes 1..0x35): 1 parent's dest set; 2 operand is IL_B_QUALIFY; 3..6 constant in 8-bit ranges; 7..10 power of two / 2^n+1 / 2^n-1 / two bits (0041c180 / 0041c120); 0xb / 0x10 small shift counts (00430e00); 0xc / 0xd / 0x20 the value 30 / 31 / 29; 0x12 0..0xff; 0x17 operand EAABS; 0x18 frame based (base 0x6c); 0x19 @Rn or @(0,Rn); 0x1a disp 1..0x38 multiple of 4; 0x1b disp -0x7f..0x7f; 0x26..0x31 shift-count sets (1, 2, 8, 16 ...); 0x2b / 0x2c GBR symbols (sym attr & 3); 0x32..0x35 int / float cast types. RETURN: the code ends MOVZX AX, byte [rules + 2*i - 1] (a byte zero-extended to 16 bits) and the only caller 00423410 reads AX (00423616 MOV DI,AX; TEST DI,DI), so unsigned char (not char) keeps the value

name: apply_template_to_node
signature: void apply_template_to_node(gen_node *node, tmpl_header *tmpl, unsigned char slot_kind, ea *extra0, ea *extra1, unsigned int operand_regs, gen_node *account_node)
note: Makes tmpl the node's code. Kind 0x10 on SH-4 (request +0x157 == 0): PR switching (tmpl flags2 0x04 wants PR 0, 0x02 PR 1: sets desc fpu_mode_flags 0x01 and g_fpscr_pr). assign_template_slot_registers 00425f60; kinds 0x10 / 0x30: fills g_template_extra_operands [0] = extra0, [1] = extra1, then EAREGD ea's of the slot array (regs_2c x5 / regs_41 x3), runs assign_move_entry_registers 00426fb0(kind + 0x10) and frees them. ORs tmpl clobbers +31 / fclobbers +42 into account_node's temp_regs / ftemp_regs and g_used_gpr_mask / g_used_fpr_mask. With extra0 set it only invalidates the clobbered contents (0042fcb0) and returns. Otherwise sets the node's value (+68) and opnd_class (+01) by tmpl->result: 0 none (opnd_class 3 when flags2 0x08), 1 / 2 the left / right operand's location (copying its busy_regs / fbusy_regs / frame_top), 3 / 4 / 10 / 12 / 13 slot register regs_2c[0..4] (reg_spec[0..4]; spec 0x2000 | 0x400000 may keep an operand register via 00425c60, opnd_class 1 when it is the target), 5 r0, 6 a bit-field constant (#imm from the right operand's +6c, masked / sign-extended to bit_width +05), 7 @(0,r2), 8 / 9 @(0,Rslot0) (8 sets ea type bit 0x40), 0xb fr0, 0xe fr3; tmpl flags2 0x08 then takes a folded right operand's value. Invalidates the written contents (0042fcb0), sets g_r0_used; records copies of IL_ID / constant operands left in scratch registers (004258c0 + 00425950 / 00425b20 from tmpl +32 / +33); tmpl flags 0x02 -> labels 00432030, 0x04 -> desc flags2 0x20, flags2 0x80 -> flags3 0x01; finally g_avoid_reg_mask from the slot registers and the value register. operand_regs = 00432110(node) (operands' register masks, gpr low / fpr high); account_node is the node itself in every caller except 00429060 (its 9th argument). Callers 00401f30, 00402d90, 004031a0, 004034e0, 004037e0, 004042e0, 0040d9e0, 0040ff00, 004111e0, 00422180, 00429060

name: template_copy_register
note: Register that holds a copy of an operand after the template, from tmpl_header +32 / +33: 3 -> regs_2c[0], 4 -> regs_2c[1], 5 -> r0, 0xb -> fr0 (0x10); a result that is not r0..r3 / fr0..fr3 (0x10..0x13) gives -1 (only scratch registers have content records). Checked against amul008 (+32 = 4, +33 = 3: its entries copy the right operand 0xaa into slot 0 and the left 0xa9 into slot 1). Only caller 00424c80

name: record_operand_copy_in_register
signature: void record_operand_copy_in_register(gen_node *node, tmpl_header *tmpl, short reg, unsigned short opnd_code, gen_node *operand)
note: reg != -1: finds the last template entry that copies operand opnd_code (0xa9 left / 0xaa right operand) into a register (macros 0xc00 / 0x2700 / 0x2b00 with it as opnd[0], 0xf00 / 0x2800 / 0x1c00 as opnd[1]), then replays the following entries (materialize_operand_record_from_descriptor, or 00426d00 for CALL; invalidate_regs_written_by_entry 00426dd0); if none writes reg, records reg's content: IL_ID (0x70) -> 0042fe80(operand) + 0042f830(operand, reg), else the constant 0042faf0(operand's value +68, reg, operand). Callers 00424c80 (left 0xa9 / right 0xaa), 00425b20

name: record_last_operand_copy_in_register
signature: void record_last_operand_copy_in_register(gen_node *node, tmpl_header *tmpl, short left_reg, short right_reg, gen_node *operand)
note: Both operands hold the same value (same IL_ID symx, or equal constants by 00420ca0): walking the entries backwards, the later copy of the left (0xa9) or right (0xaa) operand decides which register (left_reg / right_reg) gets the content record, via 00425950(node, tmpl, reg, code, operand). Only caller 00424c80 (registers from 004258c0 of tmpl +32 / +33)

name: reusable_operand_register
signature: short reusable_operand_register(gen_node *node, ea *extra0, ea *extra1, unsigned int spec, short target_reg, char slot_state)
note: For a reg_spec with 0x2000: the register of the source operand named by spec & 0x1c00 (0x400 first child, 0x800 second, 0xc00 third 004335f0(node, 3), 0x1000 fourth, 0x1400 extra0, 0x1800 extra1; the operand's mem_ea +5c / dest +74 / g_ea_pop / value +68) when it may be overwritten: an operand with opnd_class 0 always; with spec 0x400000 one with opnd_class 1; else an EAREGD (or the base of @Rn / @(disp,Rn) unless spec 0x800000 or a float slot 0x3000000) that is not a register variable (g_var_gpr_mask / g_var_fpr_mask) and, for r0..r3, whose content is already counted this statement (flags 0x80). -1 when not reusable, when it is in spec's r0..r3 exclusion bits 0..3, or equals target_reg (unless slot_state is 2). Callers 00425f60 (slot_state = the slot's state byte: 1 reused, 2 result slot), 00424c80 (2)

name: assign_template_slot_registers
signature: void assign_template_slot_registers(gen_node *node, tmpl_header *tmpl, unsigned char slot_kind, ea *extra0, ea *extra1, unsigned int operand_regs, gen_node *account_node)
note: Fills the desc register array of slot_kind (0x10 regs_2c, 0x20 regs_34, 0x30 regs_41, 0x40 regs_44, 0x50 addr_reg, 0x60 regs_3d, 0x70 reg_47; else error 0x1227) from tmpl->reg_spec[0..4] (0 ends). With tmpl flags2 & 6 (kind 0x10, desc fpu_mode_flags bit 0 clear) only slots whose register operand codes 0x5e..0x62 occur in the entries (opnd[0] / opnd[1], ops 0x3800 / 0x3900 skipped) get one. Kind 0x10: the result slot (result 3 / 8 -> slot 0, 4 -> 1, 10 -> 2) takes the target register (dest +74 / target_regs / ftarget_regs) unless r0_result_left_to_chooser 00426c90, and seeds pref_regs / fpref_regs with it. Per slot: 0x2000 tries 00425c60; kind 0x80000 a fixed register (low 4 bits), 0x100000 the register of operand n (1 / 2 children, 3 / 4 children 3 / 4, 5 / 6 extra0 / extra1); otherwise the chooser 0041fa30 (general), 0041fc40 (0x1000000 float) or 0041fde0 (0x2000000 pair) with excluded = operand_regs | spec bits 0..3 | earlier slots' registers (0x4000..0x20000 with 0x40000) | operands' registers (0x80 / 0x40 / 0x20 / 0x10 children 1..4, 0x200 / 0x100 extra0 / extra1), retried without operand_regs; error 0x1227 when none. Chosen registers are ORed into account_node's temp_regs / ftemp_regs (reused operand registers and operand-n registers are also invalidated, 0042fcb0). tmpl flags 0x08: swaps two flagged (entry flags 0x04) slots when their registers collide with the operands. Only caller 00424c80

name: r0_result_left_to_chooser
note: 1 when node->desc pref_regs == 1 (r0 wanted) and the node is IL_MUL (0x44) with a template other than amul005 / amul007 / amul008 (0044dc70 / 0044dd60 / 0044dde8, the amul templates whose result is a slot register after copying an operand), or an assignment operator (0x38..0x3d, 0x50..0x5f) of integer or pointer (0x40) type; then 00425f60 does not put the target register into the result slot (the r0 preference reaches the chooser instead). Only caller 00425f60 (tests == 0)

name: make_call_routine_operand
note: For a CALL (0x23) template entry: the runtime routine label of opnd_code: 0xfe 0041d1a0(node), 0xff 0041d080(left, node), 0x100 0041d080(right, left), 0x101 0041d050(0x101, left's type), 0x102 0041d050(0x102, node's type), 0x103 0041cfa0(node), 0x104 0041d080(left, right), 0x105 0041ced0(node); other codes the low 16 bits of g_operand_desc_table[code]; returns 00404b20(label) (an EAIMM operand with that label). RETURN: Ghidra's sig says undefined, but the body ends 00426da1 CALL 00404b20; ADD ESP,4; POP; POP; RET with 00404b20's ea * still in EAX, and both callers 00425950 / 00426fb0 use it as the entry's first operand (the rebuild's decls.h already declares int *). The pointer return is needed. Same selector set as 00412390 handles for opnd 0xfe..0x105

name: invalidate_regs_written_by_entry
signature: unsigned int invalidate_regs_written_by_entry(unsigned short op, ea *opnd1, ea *opnd2, ea *opnd3)
note: Register mask (general low 16, floating high 16, by 00430e20) that one template entry writes; invalidates those r0..r3 / fr0..fr3 contents (0042fcb0) and returns it. psd ops < 0x100: g_psd_op_written_operand (1 -> opnd1, 2 -> opnd2) unless g_psd_op_template_info byte 0 == 8; 0x20..0x22 none; 0x23 CALL: g_routine_clobbers[label of opnd1] | opnd2; 0x24..0x26 opnd3; 0x27..0x2c opnd2 | opnd3; macros ((op >> 8) - 1 < 0x3d): g_macro_written_operands bits 0x80 / 0x40 / 0x20 = opnd1 / 2 / 3. Only EAREGD (type 1) operands count. Callers 00425950 (tests the reg bit), 00426fb0

name: assign_move_entry_registers
signature: void assign_move_entry_registers(gen_node *node, tmpl_header *tmpl, unsigned char slot_kind, ea *extra0, ea *extra1, unsigned short operand_regs, gen_node *account_node)
note: Second phase of 00424c80 (slot_kind 0x20 -> regs_34 with regs_2c as the earlier slots, 0x40 -> regs_44 with regs_41; else error 0x1227): for each tmpl->reg_spec2[i] (0 ends; kinds 0x100000 / 0x80000 and flag 0x2000 are errors 0x1227) replays the entries before spec2_entry[i] (00426dd0 invalidations), builds the exclusion mask like 00425f60, materializes that move entry's two operands (equal operands 00420ca0 -> the entry is a no-op), finds the moved value's type (0x1c00 -> 0x40, 0x2b00 -> 0x18, 0x2700 / 0x2800 int / short / char by the node's type, else the type of the operand the entry's operand code reads), and lets choose_move_entry_register 004278c0(src, dst, slot_kind | i, node, op, type, excluded | operand_regs, account_node) pick the register, retried without operand_regs; then replays the remaining entries. Only caller 00424c80

name: choose_move_entry_register
signature: unsigned short choose_move_entry_register(ea *src, ea *dst, unsigned char slot, gen_node *node, unsigned short op, unsigned char value_type, unsigned int excluded, gen_node *account_node)
note: Register a template move entry (op 0xc00 / 0xd00 / 0xe00 / 0xf00 / 0x1b00 / 0x1c00 / 0x2700 / 0x2800 / 0x2b00; 0xc00 from an ea with type bit 0x40 is treated as 0xd00 of type 0x40) needs, written into the desc slot named by slot (0x10 regs_2c, 0x20 regs_34, 0x30 regs_41, 0x40 regs_44, 0x50 addr_reg, 0x60 regs_3d, 0x70 reg_47, 0x80 cond_regs; low 4 bits the index): 0xff (none) for register / frame / @Rn operands; r0 for char / short @(disp,Rn) moves with disp 1..15 / 1..30 (mov.b / mov.w @(disp,Rn),R0); a chooser 0041fa30 register for large displacements, EAABS addresses (GBR symbols, attr & 3, prefer r0), SH-4 doubles (type 0x30) and FPU constants other than 0.0 / 1.0 (g_float_zero_bits / g_float_one_bits: fldi0 / fldi1 need none). Records the loaded constant / address content (0042faf0) and invalidates the destination register's content; ORs the register into account_node's temp_regs. Returns 1 when done (or nothing needed), 0 when the chooser found no register (00426fb0 / 00429060 retry with a smaller excluded mask); 004289f0 calls it with slot 0x81, op 0xc00. Errors 0x1225 (unexpected ea kind), 0x1227 (unknown op / slot kind)

name: constant_condition_is_zero
note: callers 004289f0 and 004141b0: if the value desc+68 is an EAIMM with labels (an address) returns 0; else compares the constant at desc value.disp (+6c) with the zero constant g_zero_constant (00458ac0) by type: integer 00436380 (==), float (type&0xf8 0x28) 00437650, double 0x30/0x38 00437850, other float sizes -> message 0x1226. 004289f0 gives up on the condition when true_label is set and this says zero, or false_label is set and it says nonzero

name: assign_condition_value_registers
note: called by 0040ceb0 for desc usage 1 (a value only tested). Returns early for folded constant conditions (opnd_class 2 + 00428910). Fills desc cond_regs (+38..+3c): double (type&0xf8 0x30) without the SH-4 FPU -> r0 for the runtime compare result ([0]=0, [1]=0xff, temp_regs |= r0, 0042fcb0(1), g_r0_used); SH-4 double: a float pair via 0041fde0 into [2]/[3] (ftemp_regs +26, g_used_fpr_mask), loaded with 004278c0(value, EAREGD, 0x81, node, macro 0xc00 ...), a general register via the chooser 0041fa30 into [0], and when g_fpscr_pr must switch, a second general register into [4] (fpu_mode_flags |= 2, g_fpscr_pr set to the new mode); single float with FPU: 0041fc40 singles the same way; integer: general register via 0041fa30(busy mask from 00432110, preference r0 when 0040d690 says the operand is a small @(disp,Rn), scan flag 0), retried with the operand's own registers (00430e20) when it returns 0xff; loads the value into it (004278c0, macro 0xc00) unless already in a register (opnd_class 0/1), then invalidates that register's content (0042fcb0).
