note: returns an ald (load) template ald000..ald046 by the source kind, type, cpu / FPU and request +0x2a; for an EAABS symbol with attr & 3 loaded into r0 (dst or temp r0) it rewrites src into @(disp,GBR) (base 0x62, type EADSPGBR, labels via 00419910 / 004182c0); 0042f500 kind 1 (0042a180 and the 0042f690 path)

name: select_transfer_template
signature: tmpl_header *select_transfer_template(int forced, unsigned int kind, ea *src, ea *dst, ea *extra, char type, char reg, gen_node *node)
note: picks the code template that moves src to dst; returns the tmpl_header (the DAT_ addresses are templates named in g_template_names). kind 1 ald (0042ee70), 2 ast (0042e930), 3 alda (0042e820), 4 apusha (0042e760), 5 amv (0042ddd0), 6 apush (0042d6a0); kind 0 = choose from the operands (jump table 0042f808, case 0 written out in the rebuild source): dst @-R15 -> apush / apusha, dst a register -> ald / alda, src a register -> ast, else amv; src type bit 0x40 (address of) turns ald into alda and apush into apusha. forced == 0: returns 0 when src and dst are the same operand (00420ca0) and maps kind 1 -> 3 / 6 -> 4 for address operands; forced != 0 calls the kind's selector directly (error 0x122e / 0x122f on a bad kind). Callers 004053a0, 00406340, emit_template_record_sequence_for_node 00412390, 00413bf0, 00413d00, 00413d80, 004147f0, 0042a180. type / reg: the code pushes both with MOVSX byte (signed char)

name: record_variable_in_register
note: after an IL_ID value is loaded into r0..r3 (or fr0..fr3 for a float when the FPU keeps floats: cpu 2 with request +0x37 == 3, or cpu 4), stores {symx, abs(lreg), type, g_stmt_serial} in g_gpr_contents[reg] / g_fpr_contents[reg - 0x10] (struct reg_content), first invalidating that register (0042fcb0) and evicting the oldest content when two are held (0042fa50); sets flags 0x20 when r0 holds g_r0_variable; ORs the register into desc +1a / +28 (cached_regs / fcached_regs) of the node and its parent. Skips non-IL_ID nodes, volatile nodes (type & 2), register variables (g_lreg_table entry with a register), values already in a register (desc value type 1, unless r0 = g_r0_variable) and everything while g_content_hit is set

name: evict_oldest_register_content
note: counts the occupied entries of the 4-entry bank (value != 0 or flags 0x40); when exactly two are held, invalidates the one with the oldest stamp (+0c) through 0042fcb0 (register + 0x10 for g_fpr_contents); more than two: internal error 0x123b. Called by 0042f830 / 0042faf0 before recording, so at most two contents stay cached per bank

name: record_constant_in_register
note: counterpart of 0042f830 for an EAIMM operand: records the constant / address (value->disp, a copy of value->labels via 0042b770) in g_gpr_contents[reg] / g_fpr_contents with flags 0x40 and the current stamp, unless the register already holds the same constant from this statement; ORs the register into the node's (and parent's) desc cached_regs / fcached_regs. Callers pass (ea, register byte sign-extended, node)

name: invalidate_register_contents
note: clears the content records of the registers in mask: bits 0..3 r0..r3 (g_gpr_contents), bits 16..19 fr0..fr3 (g_fpr_contents); frees a constant's label list (004182c0). Callers 0042f830, 0042faf0, 0042fa50, 0041abe0 (g_stmt_invalidate_mask) and others

name: invalidate_variable_register_contents
note: like 0042fcb0 but only for variable contents: skips constants (flags 0x40) and array-kind types ((type & 0xe0) == 0x80); same mask layout (types.h: a child with flags2 0x02 and usage 3 calls it with 0xf000f)

name: forget_register_copies_of_variable
note: clears (value = 0) every r0..r3 (or fr0..fr3 for an FPU float) content record holding the IL_ID's variable (same symx and abs(lreg), not a constant, same type when lreg != 0): the variable was assigned

name: find_register_holding_constant
note: for an EAIMM operand (else -1) searches r0..r3 (fr0..fr3 when type is float and the FPU holds floats) for a content with flags 0x40, the same disp and the same label list (00420c50); on a hit extends its validity range (0041bda0), sets g_content_hit and returns the register (+0x10 for a floating one), else -1. Callers take the short result

name: find_register_holding_variable
note: the IL_ID counterpart of 0042ff60: finds a content record with the node's symx, abs(lreg) and type; extends its range (0041bda0) unless it is r0 holding g_r0_variable (flags 0x20); sets g_content_hit; returns the register (+0x10 floating) or -1

name: save_register_contents
note: pushes a struct reg_contents_save (FUN_00406830(0x44)) holding the first 0x10 bytes of each of g_gpr_contents[0..3] (0042b220(dst, src, 4)) onto g_gpr_contents_stack, copying constants' label lists (0042b770); same for g_fpr_contents onto g_fpr_contents_stack. Callers 00406ed0, 0040e050, 00420220, 0042a790

name: restore_register_contents
note: copies the top record of g_gpr_contents_stack / g_fpr_contents_stack back into g_gpr_contents / g_fpr_contents (the stack keeps it), copying constants' label lists again

name: drop_saved_register_contents
note: pops the top reg_contents_save of both stacks, freeing the saved label lists (004182c0) and the 0x44-byte records (00406a70)

name: select_bit_field_load_template
note: template for reading an IL_B_QUALIFY bit field: abqual001..abqual008 (004559a8, 00455a30, 00455ab8, 00455b58, 00455bd0, 00455c58, 00455ce0, 00455d70), chosen by width and offset (desc +04 / +05 within a byte, word or long; byte offset 00431f90), signedness, and whether the container address is in a scratch register; 1-bit fields of GBR symbols (sym attr & 3) take abqual008; abqual004 with usage 1 sets desc flags2 0x20. Caller 004034e0

name: select_bit_field_assign_template
note: template for an assignment to an IL_B_QUALIFY field (0040d9e0 when the left operand is op 0x35): aassgn016..018, 023..028, 039..046 by field width and offset (desc +04 / +05), a constant right operand (IL_CONST or opnd_class 2: its value picks set or clear of a 1-bit field), GBR symbols, displacement range (00431f90); default aassgn019 (00456738). before_operands: 0040d9e0 passes 1 before generating the right operand and 0 after (a 1-bit field takes aassgn044 only on the first call)

name: count_constant_shift_steps
note: number of SH shift instructions for a constant shift count: amount / 16 (SHLL16) + rest / 8 (SHLL8) + rest / 2 (SHLL2) + rest (SHLL). Callers 00430e00 and the multiply expansion 00411d00 take (short); the code builds the result in the low half only

name: is_short_constant_shift
note: count_constant_shift_steps(amount) < 4 (Ghidra bool, 1 byte). Caller 00423800 (template matrix, shift counts 0..0x1d)

name: ea_register_mask
note: registers an operand uses: for Rn, @Rn, @-Rn, @Rn+, @(disp,Rn), @(R0,Rn), @(R0,GBR) the base register as a bit (general 0..0x1f in the low half; floating 0x1f..0x2e as a pair and 0x2f..0x3c as four bits in the high half), plus bit 0 (r0) for the index kinds 9 and 12; 0 for other kinds. 34 callers test the halves

name: mask_to_register
note: number of the lowest set bit (the register a one-register mask names), -1 for 0. Callers pass desc target_regs (+14) and similar masks

name: float_mask_to_register
note: floating counterpart of 00430f00 for desc ftarget_regs (+22): 0x10 + lowest bit; two adjacent bits starting at an even one give the pair register (another +0x10, 0x20..); error 0x123c for an odd pair or a bit above 15

name: select_aggregate_assign_template
note: template for a struct / array assignment (0040d9e0 passes 0 before the operands and 1 after; 004111e0 passes 1): aassgn038 (00457088) when the size is one char / short / long; with the short at request +0x20 set: pass 0 -> aassgn032 / aassgn037 by element size, pass 1 -> unrolled copies from g_long_copy_templates / g_short_copy_templates (indexed by displacement range) or aassgn033 for co-aligned frame / symbol operands; fallback aassgn020 / 021 / 022 by the operands' registers (00430e20)

name: apply_template_operand_constraints
note: from the node's chosen template (desc +80): push_mode (+30) sets the operands' desc flags2 0x08 (pushed) / 0x04 (8-byte push) (1 both, 2 left 8-byte + right, 3 left, 4 left 8-byte, 5 right); copies pref_left / pref_right (+2c / +2e) and fpref_left / fpref_right (+3c / +3e) into the first and second operands' desc +12 / +20. Callers 00401f30, 004034e0, 0040d9e0, finalize_x_node_from_child_chain, 00422180

name: set_assignment_result_value
note: after an assignment (caller 0040d9e0): gives the node's desc the value operand (+68, copied with 0042b7e0), busy_regs, fbusy_regs, frame_top and opnd_class of the right operand when its value is in a register, else of the left (destination) operand (flags3 0x08, plus 0x80 when no template); for struct / array assignments it decides by the amv template the copy uses (0042ddd0: amv008 / 012 / 014 -> @(0,r2), amv016 / 018 / 019 / 021 / 023 -> through the register at desc +41, amv024 -> the destination), building an EADISP operand with 0042b180 and opnd_class 3

name: map_code_node_opcode_to_late_handler_index
note: existing name kept: -1 for IL_NULL (0x6f); g_late_handler_index_by_op[op] (0..0x2f) for op >= 0x20, else error 0x1222 (op is the gen_node's il_op). Callers dispatch_and_finalize_code_node, 004111e0

name: reuse_operand_value_for_cast
note: for an IL_CAST (caller 00422180: op 0x20, not pointer kind) whose operand's desc has flags2 0x20: the cast takes the operand's busy_regs, fbusy_regs, frame_top, value operand and opnd_class (flags3 0x80 and 0x08) and generates no code; returns 1, else 0

name: bit_field_byte_offset
note: byte offset of a bit field inside its unit: bit_offset / 8 (desc +04), or with request +0x2a (bit-field order) set (unit bytes 0042b820 * 8 - offset - width) / 8. Callers materialize_operand_record_from_descriptor, 00430490, 00430890

name: bit_field_word_offset
note: the same bit position as 00431f90 rounded down to its 16-bit word: (bits / 16) * 2. Callers materialize_operand_record_from_descriptor, 00430890

name: make_template_labels
note: walks tmpl->entries (+38, 12-byte entries up to op 0xff00) and makes a new label (0042b1e0) for each LABEL (0x18) entry, two per 8-byte label_ref cell (FUN_00406830(8)), the list in desc +50 (template_labels). Caller 00424c80 for templates with flags 0x02

name: find_template_label
note: label number of the template's n-th LABEL entry (1-based) from desc +50: odd n -> labno1, even n -> labno2 of cell (n - 1) / 2; 0 if missing. Caller emit_template_record_sequence_for_node takes (short) | callers use the low half

name: result_reg_exclusion_mask
note: excluded-register mask for choosing the node's result register: desc busy_regs (+16) | fbusy_regs (+24) << 16, minus the temp_regs / ftemp_regs (+18 / +26) of its first two operands (their registers may be reused) and minus r0 when an operand is an absolute or labelled symbol with GBR attr (sym attr & 3), plus g_var_gpr_mask | g_var_fpr_mask << 16. Callers pass the low half to the chooser 0041fa30 and the high half to 0041fc40 / 0041fde0 (25 callers)

name: compute_record_code_size
note: SH code bytes of a psd record: g_op_code_size_table[op]; CTBL count * 4; OP_NON_10 even length + 2; ENTER 0x36 / 0x5a and EXIT 0x30 / 0x54 (FPU mode: cpu 2 or 4 with request +0x37 == 3); RETURN 0x10; MOV_LOC 6; MOVA_LC 4; MOVI -2 without misc 0x40; 0x2c 4 or 6; MOV +2 for MOV Rn,R0 with request +0x13d bit 4; flg 0x40 -2. Same job as shcpep compute_record_code_size 0041ac60 but simpler (no aux-record terms). Callers: the write_ofa_* writers, 0042ab90, 0042baa0

name: write_sua_record
note: = shcpep write_sub_record 0041b250 (same code; the stream is .sua here): sets g_sua_filno 1, g_sua_linno 0, g_sua_report_extra_arg 0, writes the op byte and dispatches on g_sua_record_format_table[op][0] to the writers below; op > 0xf1 or format 0: 0x1318; bad format 0x1319. Caller 0042ab90

name: write_sua_casejmp_record
note: = shcpep write_sub_casejmp_record: expno (4), filno (2), linno (2), +0x10 (4), +0x14 (4)

name: write_sua_cent_record
note: = shcpep write_sub_cent_record: 2 bytes at +0x10

name: write_sua_ctbl_record
note: = shcpep write_sub_ctbl_record: the shorts at +0xc and +0xe

name: write_sua_label_record
note: = shcpep write_sub_label_record: label number (+0x10, 2) and sptravel (4)

name: write_sua_line_record
note: = shcpep write_sub_line_record: sets g_sua_filno / g_sua_linno, writes filno, linno and 1 byte at +0x10

name: write_sua_machine_op_record
note: = shcpep write_sub_machine_op_record: filno, linno, expno, flg, misc, operand count (checked against g_sua_record_format_table[op][1], error 0x1310), then each operand via write_sua_operand(out, ea, flg & 3)

name: write_sua_operand
note: = shcpep write_sub_operand 0041b5f0 (same size, 699 bytes): type byte, base (control registers - 0x61, system registers - 0x64), displacement / GBR / immediate value sized by size (0..2) with range checks (0x1311, 0xc1c), labels via write_sua_label_list, index nibbles

name: count_label_ref_markers
note: = shcpep count_label_ref_markers 0041b8e0: counts labno1 / labno2 equal to -0x8000; write_sua_operand requires exactly one on a labelled @(disp,GBR)

name: write_sua_label_list
note: = shcpep write_sub_label_list 0041b910: 4-byte count of the nonzero label numbers, then each as 2 bytes

name: write_sua_instruction_record
note: = shcpep write_sub_instruction_record 0041b9b0 (same size 1338 bytes, same messages 0x1313 / 0x1314 / 0x1317 / 0x1318): format 8, the pseudo instructions ENTER .. 0x31

name: write_sua_op10_record
note: = shcpep write_sub_op10_record: sets g_sua_filno / g_sua_linno, writes filno, linno, +0x10 (4), +0x14 (4)

name: write_sua_section_record
note: = shcpep write_sub_section_record: the 2-byte section number at +0xc

name: write_sua_bytes
signature: void write_sua_bytes(FILE *out, char *buf, unsigned int n)
note: = shcpep write_sub_bytes 0041bfa0: write_file_bytes, error 0xce7 through 00422100(g_sua_filno, g_sua_linno, ...) when it returns -1

name: read_file_bytes
signature: unsigned int read_file_bytes(FILE *in, char *buf, unsigned int n)
note: = shcpep read_file_bytes 0041bff0 (same code): __fread_lk(buf, 1, n, in); -1 for null arguments, n < 1 or an error, 0 at end of file. 36 callers (.ilb readers, request loader)

name: write_file_bytes
signature: unsigned int write_file_bytes(FILE *out, char *buf, unsigned int n)
note: = shcpep write_file_bytes 0041c050 (same code): fwrite(buf, n, 1, out) (0043ab90); returns n or -1

name: init_gen_node_pool
note: pool constructor (types.h): with node_size > 0x27 and count > 0 stores g_gen_node_size, callocs count nodes (0043a6a0(1, size)) chained through +14 (g_gen_node_free_head .. g_gen_node_free_tail) and allocates g_ilb_operand_counts (0x800 x 4); returns 0, or -1 on failure. Caller 00415cd0(0x2c, 0x800) tests the short

name: operand_position
note: 1-based position of node among its parent's operands (parent->child, ->next ...), -1 without a parent or when not found. 6 callers

name: find_previous_operand
note: the operand before node in its parent's list; 0 when node is the first, has no parent or is not found. Caller 004333d0

name: unlink_and_free_subtree
note: unlinks node from its parent's operand list (parent->child, or the previous operand's next, = node->next; g_unlink_parent), frees it with its subtree (00433490) and, when g_ilb_cursor was the parent, recomputes g_ilb_depth. 11 callers (00415cd0 after each function, 004349a0 for the old IL_FILE root)

name: free_gen_node_subtree
note: frees node (00433500) and, recursively, its operands; moves g_ilb_cursor to g_unlink_parent when it pointed at node and clears it for a parentless IL_FILE

name: free_gen_node
note: appends node to the free list (g_gen_node_free_tail->next) and clears it: fields +00..+27 one by one, then g_gen_node_size - 0x28 bytes (the desc pointer)

name: alloc_gen_node
note: takes g_gen_node_free_head (advancing through +14), clears its next and stores op; when the head has reached the tail calls g_gen_node_exhausted_handler and returns 0. Callers read_ilb_node 00433720, 0040fca0 (IL_CONST 0x71)

name: prepend_operand
note: makes operand the first operand of parent (operand->next = parent->child, parent->child = operand, operand->parent = parent); low half 0, or 0xffff when operand->next is already set. Caller 0040fca0 ignores the result

name: nth_operand
note: n-th operand (1-based) of node; 0 when n < 1 or there are fewer. 20 callers

name: count_operands
note: number of operands (child, next ...). 13 callers

name: last_operand
note: last operand of node, 0 if none (the attach helpers append after it)

name: set_gen_node_exhausted_handler
note: stores handler in g_gen_node_exhausted_handler (shcgen_main passes 0041a8c0); low half 0, or 0xffff for a null handler

name: find_symbol_request_entry_a
note: searches req->entry11_list_0bc (request_entry; the symbol number is the short at +0e = c[2..3]) for symx and stores the entry's a word (+04) in *out; returns 1 found, 0 not. Caller 004053a0 for an IL_ID call target whose sym_flags has 0x40: with 004336e0 it supplies the two words of an OP_NON_10 record (0042b110, op 0x10, whose +0x14 is a length), else error 0x1248. What the entries are (a pragma?) is not established

name: find_symbol_request_entry_b
note: as 004336a0, returning the entry's b word (+08)

name: read_ilb_node
note: reads one .ilb record: the op byte, alloc_gen_node(op), clears g_ilb_record_buffer, reads the type byte where the op has one and calls the per-shape reader (00433b20 .. 004346e0; unknown op: 0x12d4, exit 0xb; read error 0xce6, exit 9), then attaches the node (004347a0). Returns the node, -1 at end of file, 0 when the pool is empty (Ghidra: uint). Callers 00415cd0, read_ilb_tree 00435480 and others

name: read_ilb_untyped_node
note: shape without a type byte (IL_FILE, E_FILE, E_BLOCK, EMPTY, IF, FOR, WHILE, DO, BREAK, CONTINUE, NULL, ARG, E_ARG): 6 bytes filn, line, listno; IL_E_BLOCK when stage != 1 reads 7, the 7th the blkflg byte at +18

name: read_ilb_typed_node
note: operators of a scalar type (00433720 read the type byte): filn, line, listno (6 bytes); for stage 2 and IL_COMMA / IL_ASSIGN / IL_A_ADD / A_SUB / A_MUL / A_DIV one more byte into +20 (FR0set)

name: read_ilb_aggregate_node
note: as 00433c20 for struct / array types ((type & 0xe0) == 0x60 / 0x80): 10 bytes, the aggregate size (+18) first

name: read_ilb_call_node
note: IL_CALL: 8 bytes: call_06 (+06, one byte widened), call flags (+20), filn, line, listno

name: read_ilb_aggregate_call_node
note: IL_CALL returning a struct: 12 bytes, the size (+18) then as 00433e00

name: read_ilb_symbol_node
note: nodes with a symbol number (IL_FUNC, BLOCK, SWITCH, GOTO, GLABEL, CLABEL, DLABEL, IL_ID): symx (+02), filn, line, listno; with stage != 1 IL_BLOCK adds blkflg (+18) and IL_ID adds lreg (+24) and, for stage 2, FR0set (+20)

name: read_ilb_qualify_node
note: IL_QUALIFY: member offset (+1c), filn, line, listno (10 bytes)

name: read_ilb_aggregate_qualify_node
note: IL_QUALIFY of a struct / array member: size (+18), offset (+1c), filn, line, listno (14 bytes)

name: read_ilb_bit_qualify_node
note: IL_B_QUALIFY: type (+05), unit offset (+1c), bit_offset (+01), bit_width (+04), filn, line, listno (13 bytes)

name: read_ilb_word_const_node
note: IL_CONST of an integer or float type: the 4-byte value (+18), filn, line, listno (10 bytes)

name: read_ilb_double_const_node
note: IL_CONST of type 0x30 (double): the 8-byte value (+18, +1c), filn, line, listno

name: read_ilb_long_double_const_node
note: IL_CONST of type 0x38: the 12-byte value (+18 .. +23), filn, line, listno

name: read_ilb_pointer_const_node
note: IL_CONST of pointer kind (0x40): the 2-byte word (+24), the value (+18), filn, line, listno (12 bytes)

name: read_ilb_incdec_node
note: IL_PRI / PRD / POI / POD: type (+05), step (+18), filn, line, listno (11 bytes)

name: read_ilb_asm_node
note: IL_ASM: asmno (+18), asmsize (+1c), filn, line, listno (14 bytes)

name: attach_ilb_node
note: links a node just read into the tree at g_ilb_cursor: the first node becomes the root (operand counts cleared); otherwise recomputes g_ilb_depth from the cursor and dispatches on op: IL_FILE 004349a0, E_FILE 004350f0, FUNC / ASM 00434a20, BLOCK 00434b30, E_BLOCK 004351a0, EMPTY / BREAK / CONTINUE / GOTO 00434e10, other statements 00434ce0, ID / CONST 00434f30, ARG 00434ff0, E_ARG 004352c0, operators 004353c0. Returns the node, or -1 when the helper returned 0. Caller read_ilb_node

name: begin_ilb_file
note: IL_FILE: pops to the old IL_FILE root and frees that tree (004333d0), clears g_ilb_operand_counts and g_ilb_depth and makes node the cursor. RETURN: Ghidra says undefined, but the code returns node (MOV EAX,[ESP+4] at 00434a10) and attach_ilb_node uses it (the rebuild already declares gen_node *)

name: attach_ilb_function
note: IL_FUNC / IL_ASM: pops to the previous FUNC / ASM and chains node after it (next, same parent), or appends it to the IL_FILE root; counts the operand and descends. Returns node

name: attach_ilb_block
note: IL_BLOCK: pops to the nearest statement container (FUNC, BLOCK, IF, SWITCH, FOR, WHILE, DO, CLABEL, DLABEL, GLABEL; none: 0x12d7, exit 0xb), climbs further while that one is complete (00434c70), appends node as its last operand and descends. RETURN: Ghidra says undefined, but both paths end with EAX = node (00434c17 / 00434c26; the recursive path returns its result) and attach_ilb_node uses it (the rebuild declares undefined4)

name: ilb_node_operands_full
note: 1 when the node at depth has all its operands (g_ilb_operand_counts[depth] == -1 = closed, or count >= g_il_op_arity[op]), 0 when it takes more (arity -1 = any number); arity -2: error 0x12d5, exit 0xb. The code sets only AX (MOV AX,1 / XOR AX,AX); all 9 callers test (short) | callers use the low half

name: attach_ilb_statement
note: statements with operands (SWITCH, IF, FOR, WHILE, DO, RETURN, GLABEL, CLABEL, DLABEL): pops to the nearest statement container (as 00434b30), climbs past complete ones, appends node and descends; returns node, 0 without a container

name: attach_ilb_jump_statement
note: EMPTY, BREAK, CONTINUE, GOTO: as 00434ce0 but IL_FUNC is not a container; returns node or 0

name: attach_ilb_leaf_operand
note: IL_ID / IL_CONST: climbs from the cursor past complete nodes and appends node as the next operand of the first open one (the cursor moves to it); returns node, 0 at depth 0

name: attach_ilb_argument
note: IL_ARG: pops to the enclosing IL_CALL (climbing past a complete one), appends node, counts it (no 0x7f cap) and descends; returns node or 0

name: attach_ilb_file_end
note: IL_E_FILE: pops to the IL_FILE root, appends node and marks the root closed (count -1); returns node or 0

name: attach_ilb_block_end
note: IL_E_BLOCK: pops to the enclosing IL_BLOCK, appends node and marks the block closed (count -1), and the function too when the block's parent is the IL_FUNC; returns node or 0

name: attach_ilb_argument_end
note: IL_E_ARG: pops to the enclosing IL_ARG, appends node and marks the argument closed; returns node or 0

name: attach_ilb_operator
